title: Shortest Routes I
statement: There are $n$ cities and $m$ flight connections between them. Your task is to determine the length of the shortest route from Syrjälä to every city. Syrjälä is city $1$, and the other cities are numbered $2,3,\dots,n$.
inputFormat:
The first input line has two integers $n$ and $m$: the number of cities and flight connections. The cities are numbered $1, 2, \dots, n$, and city $1$ is Syrjälä.
Then, there are $m$ lines describing the flight connections. Each line has three integers $a$, $b$, and $c$: a flight begins at city $a$, ends at city $b$, and its length is $c$. Each flight is a one-way flight.
outputFormat: Print $n$ integers: the shortest route lengths from Syrjälä to cities $1, 2, \dots, n$.
